mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or t-test p-value for mean return difference exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, preceding market rallies through avoided hard landing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and falling FEDFUNDS fails to produce positive returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term regression coefficient has p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes with strong GDP growth (GDPC1) and high residential investment (RSAFS), S&P 500 underperforms due to overvaluation and profit-taking, causing negative forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods (GDPC1 growth >2% and RSAFS >450,000), SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or regime-specific return difference p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,000.0 (thousands of units), it signals residential sector contraction that reduces economic activity and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0, or t-test p-value for mean return difference exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates supply shock disrupting production without economic contraction, causing inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of declining INDPRO and rising GDPC1 fails to produce negative returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term regression coefficient has p<0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), a federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or interaction term regression coefficient has p<0.05.
